facts.label: Said / told me + passado
facts.sub: Use said + frase ou told me + frase, com o verbo um passo para trás: is → was, can → could. Told sempre pede uma pessoa.

facts.label: Disse que…
facts.sub: Use said + frase com o verbo um passo para trás: He said the kitchen was closed. Não precisa de that, mas pode usar. Said não leva pessoa direto: said to me.

facts.label: Me disse que…
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa + frase: He told me they had no fish. Told sempre precisa da pessoa: told me, told her. Não diga told that sem pessoa.

compare.ask: He said the kitchen was closed.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ele disse que a cozinha estava fechada”.
compare.tip: Diga: “He said the kitchen was closed.”
compare.us: Em inglês: He said the kitchen was closed. O verbo vai para o passado: is → was, can → could. Use told + pessoa: He told me.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: He said the kitchen was closed uses the past.
We say He told that the kitchen was closed.
items.why: Told needs a person: He told me that…

items.s: Said and told are exactly the same in grammar.
items.why: Told needs a person after it.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: He said the kitchen was closed uses the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say He told that the kitchen was closed. → Falso (Told needs a person: He told me that…)
Said and told are exactly the same in grammar. → Falso (Told needs a person after it.)
